facts.claim: ROUTE-0136 uses resolved /settings/plugins/:server/:toolName, electron:true wrapper jZ, access-status wrapper tFs, Suspense fallback and NFs. tFs returns null while loading, children when allowed, and replace-navigation to / for denied/error. Authentication, electron wrapper effective value and initialization order remain delegated; no whole-product mode classification follows.

NFs lazily requests McpExtensionSettingsViewPage from view-page-f7294bafeea7; the shim imports n as t and exports t under that name; target exports it as n. it chooses explicit hostId or selected host, reads host views and passes settings:true, selection, embedded, inheritHostBackground and lifetime to K. embedded defaults false and lifetime defaults component.

K obtains server/toolName from explicit selection or route selection. It matches the selected view by server and readTool when present, otherwise tool.name. Under Oe, an absent match renders Fe with loading from isFetching or local retry pending. Retry sets pending, invokes refetch, sends errors to at and clears pending in finally. Without the guarded retry branch, no match renders q. Neither a retry click nor finally proves a successful server refresh.

No matching view has an explicit MCP app view not found state. A matching view with updateTool renders imported Ge from page-2c23f2b4f0e0, while another matching view renders ot and passes embedded/background/lifetime. This is view display/selection, distinct from configuring MCP server entries or navigating to an extension catalog.

ot derives a view identity and app-id query using hostId/server/toolName/resourceUri/identity/lifetime. A global entrypoint selects app lifetime; st delegates app-lifetime allocation to Q and uses A otherwise. For a settings entrypoint, the frame receives component lifetime alone or another lifetime plus mcpAppId, fullSurface=!embedded, inherited background and parsed deep link. Allocation/release effects remain external; do not infer component unmount destroys all app-lifetime state.

ot retains non-settings persistent-workspace/global surface branches separately from the settings frame. Je inspects location state and pluginId, returning children normally or Ye(url) for its matching plugin case. No automatic mutation, permission grant, model task or durable settings write is proven by this UI route.

Adopt FSC-0507 as the distinct user goal of opening and viewing a selected MCP app settings view. FSC-0115 browses/configures server entries; FSC-0122 navigates to the extension catalog. These are related navigation contexts, not substitutes for this view lifecycle. T16 owns the new goal; retain shared renderer/host boundaries and unknown product mode.
